audit.why: Level 3 is Ryze's (Flux-Q from outside her 450-range W, root her E engage), 4-5 swing to Lissandra (E-W engages plus Q zoning), 6 is even (single-target Tomb), items onward Ryze. Full sides were stale.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lissandra called he/him in 12+ fields; cooldowns field had no digit; two bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim; the untargetable self-cast Frozen Tomb (missingInteractions: don't dump spells into it, and it heals her) reached neither layer's item advice.
audit.why: Lissandra is she/her. E Glacial Path: 24s at rank 1, 12s max — her engage AND escape. W Ring of Frost: 450 range, 10-8s. Q Ice Shard: 7-3s. Self-cast R makes her untargetable, invulnerable and healing — burst spent into the tomb is wasted and Grievous timing matters after it.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed, cooldowns rewritten with 24s/12s/450-range/10s/11s numbers, bleed bullets replaced with Q-window and E-W-spacing bodies, tomb warning added to itemization.

edits.before: - Lissandra Glacial Path (Claw): matchup-defining — Her engage and escape in one button — she is immobile while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Lissandra Glacial Path (Claw): 24s at rank 1, 12s max — engage and escape in one button; she is immobile while it is down. - Her W Ring of Frost roots at only 450 range on a 10s CD — space outside it. - W Rune Prison (11s) is the lifeline; chip never gets it.
